# Farlish Studio

> High-Converting Modern Web Design & Development Agency for Small Businesses, Local Contractors, and Startups.

Farlish Studio builds high-performance, conversion-engineered websites that turn curious visitors into paying clients. Utilizing modern frameworks including Framer, Webflow, and custom code (HTML5/Tailwind/Next.js), Farlish Studio delivers agency-grade digital experiences in 2–4 days at transparent small-business rates starting at $399.

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Design](https://farlish.com/#services): Bespoke UI/UX design tailored for brand identity and high conversion rates.
- [High-Converting Landing Pages](https://farlish.com/#services): Conversion-rate-optimized (CRO) single-page funnels engineered for paid ads and organic discovery.
- [Small Business & Contractor Websites](https://farlish.com/#portfolio): Full multi-page web presence for home services, medical, legal, and local trades.
- [E-Commerce & Booking Platforms](https://farlish.com/#pricing): Storefronts, appointment scheduling, and payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Calendly, PayPal).
- [SEO & Speed Optimization](https://farlish.com/#services): 95+ Google PageSpeed scores, multi-entity schema markup, and Google Search Console indexing.

## Pricing Packages (Transparent & Fixed)

- **Starter Launch ($399 USD)**: Single high-converting landing page, 2–4 days delivery, 100% responsive, lead capture form, WhatsApp integration, and on-page SEO.
- **Standard Business ($799 USD)**: 3 to 5 custom pages, 5–7 days delivery, interactive project cost estimator, local SEO schema, Google reviews integration, and CMS setup.
- **Growth & Store ($1,499 USD)**: Full multi-page platform or e-commerce store, 10–14 days delivery, payment gateway & booking workflows, advanced animation, and 30-day priority support.

## Key Differentiators

- **Lightning-Fast Turnaround**: Delivered in days (2–7 days), not months.
- **Transparent Rates**: Fixed pricing without the standard $5,000+ agency markup.
- **Conversion-First Engineering**: Built with proven psychological triggers, fast load times, and frictionless booking widgets.
- **Global & US Reach**: Serving United States businesses, UAE/Middle East clients, and global startups.
